item.tib: bar do cig chod kyi gdam pa myur lam 'pho ba ye shes skar mda' chen po
item.coloph: ces 'pho ba ye shes skar mda' chen mo 'di ni/ nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya'i mgo nag gang gi (gis) kyang 'gran zla bral ba yongs 'dzin dam pa g.yung drung bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / thos bsam gyi rgya mtsho nas bsgom rtogs kyi nor bu len pas(pa'i) sman ri sku mdun rad na khi khar dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi zhabs rdul spyi bo'i gtsug tu len pas(pa'i) mu la ha ra bdag gi(gis) dad pa'i rta zhon brtson 'grus kyi lcags bzung nas/ lcags khyi zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la bgyis pa/ yi ge pa ni ngag dbang blo gros gyi (kyis) byas te//
